title: dactylorhiza maculata
intro: Dactylorhiza maculata, commonly known as Spotted Marsh Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the wetlands of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve respiratory function, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza maculata include its vasodilatory and expectorant effects, which help to relax blood vessels and promote the expulsion of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza maculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
